# Psalms of Solomon — Psalm 14 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Vindobonensis) | **Section:** God Keeps Faith with Those Who Love Him

---

**14:1** The LORD keeps faith with those who love him in truth —
with those who bear his discipline;

**14:2** with those who walk in the righteousness of his commands,
in the law he gave us for our life.

**14:3** The devout of the LORD will live by it forever —
they are the trees of life in the LORD's own Paradise.

**14:4** Their planting is rooted so deep they will never be uprooted —
not for all the days of heaven.

**14:5** For Israel is the portion and inheritance of God.

**14:6** But not so for sinners and transgressors,
who love nothing except the brief days of their sinful pleasure;

**14:7** their delight is in passing corruption,
and God never enters their minds.

**14:8** For the ways of men lie open before the LORD;
he knows what the heart holds before any thought is formed.

**14:9** Therefore their inheritance is Hades, darkness, and destruction —
they will not be found on the day when the righteous receive mercy.

**14:10** But the devout of the LORD will inherit life — and it will be full of joy!

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering prioritizing poetic force and contemporary resonance.*
